title: Aqua Verse
description: AquaVerse expands aquatic biodiversity of minecraft
body:
# AquaVerse
AquaVerse breathes new life into Minecraft's oceans, transforming them from barren expanses into thriving, dangerous deep-sea ecosystems.

## What AquaVerse Adds
### Dunkleosteus
A massive armored predator from the Devonian era. With 100 HP, a bone-crushing bite, and the ability to shatter boats from below, this apex predator turns every ocean expedition into a survival horror experience.

### Giant Isopod
Deep-sea scavengers that swarm across the ocean floor. They scavenge shipwrecks, flee from danger, and can even be captured in a bucket. Feed them fish or watch them swarm in packs — these alien crustaceans bring the seafloor to life.

### Dunkleosteus Skull
A decorative trophy block that opens its jaw with a right-click or redstone signal. 

## Features
- Fully animated creatures powered by GeckoLib
- Unique AI behaviors — hunting, scavenging, fleeing, and swarm mechanics
- Giant Isopods can be bucketed and relocated
- Dunkleosteus breaks boats from below
- Interactions between mobs
